EntraId.Domain: REQUIRED — your org domain e.g. uerre.mx
EntraId.TenantId: REQUIRED — Azure Portal > App registrations > Directory (tenant) ID
EntraId.ClientId: REQUIRED — Azure Portal > App registrations > Application (client) ID
EntraId.Audience: REQUIRED — api://{ClientId} (must match Expose an API in app registration)

ConnectionStrings.DefaultConnection: REQUIRED — Supabase Transaction Pooler — Host=aws-{REGION}.pooler.supabase.com;Port=6543;Database=postgres;Username=postgres.{PROJECT_REF};Password=SECRET_IN_DEV_JSON;SSL Mode=Require;Trust Server Certificate=true;Maximum Pool Size=20;Minimum Pool Size=1;Connection Idle Lifetime=30;Keepalive=15;Command Timeout=30

Supabase.ServiceKey: SECRET — sb_secret_... from Supabase Dashboard > Project Settings > API > Secret keys (put in appsettings.Development.json only)

Resend.ApiKey: SECRET — re_... from resend.com Dashboard > API Keys (put in appsettings.Development.json only)
